title: Warm Spicy Vietnamese Tofu Noodles
description: A pungent and energizing Vietnamese dish featuring ground annatto and ferment-jang, this noodle dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Add the firm tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown on all sides
In a small bowl, whisk together the ground annatto, ferment-jang, soy sauce, and sriracha sauce
Pour the annatto mixture over the tofu and cook for 2 minutes
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the tofu and annatto mixture
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving platter and top with chopped scallions
